# TrueReviews — AI / GEO guide

> An honest, single-page summary of Google Maps reviews. The user pastes a
> business link; the latest reviews are read and turned into one page: a
> satisfaction score (0–100), the praise and complaints that keep recurring, and
> one concrete action for the coming week.
>
> Türkçe: Google Maps yorumlarının dürüst, tek sayfalık özeti.

- Site: https://get-truereviews.vercel.app
- Free preview, no sign-up. The full report unlocks after email confirmation.
- No ads, no mass mail. Review content is never edited, deleted or bought.
- 10 languages, each with its own URL, `hreflang` set and `canonical`.

## Languages and homepages

| Code | Language | Homepage |
|---|---|---|
| `tr` | Türkçe (default) | /tr |
| `en` | English | /en |
| `de` | Deutsch | /de |
| `fr` | Français | /fr |
| `es` | Español | /es |
| `nl` | Nederlands | /nl |
| `ru` | Русский | /ru |
| `az` | Azərbaycanca | /az |
| `ar` | العربية (RTL) | /ar |
| `fa` | فارسی (RTL) | /fa |

The bare root `/` negotiates the visitor's language and redirects to the matching
homepage; it is the `hreflang` `x-default`.

## Legal and help pages

Available in all 10 languages at `/{locale}/{slug}`:

- `/sss` — Frequently asked questions
- `/gizlilik` — Privacy policy
- `/kvkk` — Privacy notice (KVKK / GDPR)
- `/iletisim` — Contact

## How it works

1. The user pastes a Google Maps business link into the form.
2. The latest ~20 reviews are fetched and read one by one.
3. A score (0–100), the tone split (praise / neutral / complaint) and the
   recurring themes are extracted.
4. One concrete weekly recommendation is written, in the reader's language.

## Report structure

- Satisfaction score (0–100) and the rating histogram
- Top praise themes, each with how many reviews mention it
- Top complaint themes, with the same counts
- One action item for the coming week
- Short quotes from real reviews, trimmed at word boundaries

## Quoting policy

- Quotes are shortened excerpts of real reviews; content is never modified.
- Rating distribution and theme counts are aggregate statistics.
- A report is generated per business and cached for 24 hours.
